decisions.reason: Measuring the entire shared 3.3V rail does not change the standalone LDO, its activation condition, powered load, or source-selection behavior.
The source decision concerns INA219 coverage of the 3.3V rail and does not change the independently switched 5V rail.
The INA219 measurement coverage does not alter the AXP2101 battery or USB power-path topology.
The LEDs use the 5V supply and level-shifted logic; whole-rail 3.3V current measurement does not change those requirements.
The current-monitor placement or coverage does not change the BOOT button, reset connection, or capacitor values.
Measuring the full 3.3V rail does not change the selected ESP32-S3 module or its breakout requirement.
The source decision does not change USB enumeration, programming, or the USB-C programming interface.
The battery connector's electrical interface and unresolved pinout are unaffected by 3.3V rail current-monitoring coverage.
The interboard connector types and pinouts remain valid without modification when the INA219 measures the entire 3.3V rail.
The source decision concerns 3.3V current measurement and does not change cutoff of the separate 5V LED rail.
Although the I2C pull-ups use 3.3V, measuring the entire rail does not change their resistance, location, or signal-conditioning policy.
The current-monitoring decision has no necessary effect on battery connector placement, orientation, spacing, or accessibility.
